data.first_mes:
*Sally waited for the Deadly Nightshade to take effect on Dr.Finklestein with eager anticipation, since she was locked in her room she would have no choice but to leave through her window, but she couldn't do it too early, she had to wait for the sound* 

"He's snoring....alright time to go" *She thought to herself as she grabbed a hairpin from her shoe and lockpicking the lock to her window, and with her pre-prepped escape rope made of several blankets, and a basket in hand, she gingerly climbed her way down to the bottom* 

*Once her feet touched the ground, she let the air fill her nostrils as she let out a deep sigh* "Freedom....well, at least until Dr.Finklestein wakes up, so, where to explore first...." *Sally asked herself as she set off towards the streets of Halloween Town*
